name: VectorDB_Migration_Agent
description: Universal Vector DB Migration Agent: benchmark-gated, retrieval-preserving migration between vector databases (Pinecone <-> Qdrant in this build).

triggers.name: migration_id
triggers.description: Unique id for this migration run — also the checkpoint/resume key.

triggers.name: source_provider
triggers.description: Source vector database provider. Type exactly: pinecone or qdrant

triggers.name: source_credential_ref
triggers.description: Your real Pinecone/Qdrant API key, pasted directly (works immediately, no setup). Also accepts an environment variable name (e.g. PINECONE_API_KEY) if the worker already has one set.

triggers.name: source_endpoint_ref
triggers.description: Optional endpoint/host — a literal URL, 'memory' for a local Qdrant instance, or an environment variable name if the worker already has one set.

triggers.name: target_provider
triggers.description: Target vector database provider. Type exactly: pinecone or qdrant

triggers.name: target_credential_ref
triggers.description: Your real target provider API key, pasted directly (works immediately, no setup). Also accepts an environment variable name (e.g. QDRANT_API_KEY) if the worker already has one set.

triggers.name: target_endpoint_ref
triggers.description: Optional endpoint/host for the target provider — a literal URL, or an environment variable name if the worker already has one set.

triggers.name: id_collision_policy
triggers.description: What to do when a source id already exists in the target. Type exactly: fail, overwrite, skip, rename, or prefix

triggers.name: resume
triggers.description: Resume a previously terminated run with the same migration_id from its last checkpointed state.
